sub.zh: Wrisp 的四步都在本机完成：先说一句或写一段，它会自动识别类型，进入当日日志流，再整理成信息卡片。
sub.en: All four steps run on your machine: say or type a line, Wrisp identifies its type, adds it to the day's journal, then files it as an info card.

1b.zh: 在记录时，不用想存到哪个文件夹
1b.en: Recording time: no folder to pick first.

2b.zh: 类型清楚就直接记录，最多追问两轮
2b.en: Clear type: it proceeds. Unclear: at most two follow-ups.

3b.zh: 进入日志流后仍可修改
3b.en: Still editable afterwards: change the text or the type.

4b.zh: 有把握的直接整理，拿不准的先问你
4b.en: Confident ones are filed directly; unsure ones ask first.
